{# The header's search box: Pagefind's, in place of the theme's (see scripts/docs_search.py). Results link root-relative ("/setup/x.html"), so base-url is the site's root path as this page sees it, which keeps links right under a hosted prefix such as Read the Docs' /en/stable/. A page opened from disk (file://, the offline bundle) cannot run the search: browsers refuse its module script and index fetches there. The box is replaced with a note saying how to serve the bundle instead of failing silently. #}

Search needs the docs served over HTTP: python3 -m http.server
